verdict.rationale: Circle's Agent Stack explicitly documents Agent Wallets that let AI agents hold and spend USDC with customizable spending controls and built-in compliance guardrails, plus x402 nanopayments and CLI/API flows for agent-initiated payments. This is first-party documentation of exactly the scoped-authority agent payment flow described, though missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of these agent wallet spend controls in production and more detail on how humans configure the policies.
